stanza: And so you see I have come to doubt
All that I once held as true
The only truth I know is you

beliefs.line: Who has hurt all mankind just to save his own beliefs?
stanza: Let them all pass all their dirty remarks (One love)
There is one question I'd really love to ask (One heart)
Is there a place for the hopeless sinners
Who has hurt all mankind just to save his own beliefs?
What would be the use in becoming
What glows beneath? (Beneath all the pain and anguish)
While we stretch at its meaning
